newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares nervous near close, down 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares nervous near close, down 2.2 pct.

text.p: ** Bombay shares trade two percent lower in nervous trade near close
** Benchmark stocks index down 83.06 points, or 2.28 percent, to 3567.82 in late trade
** Congress party orders its lawmakers in parliament to vote against Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda in a confidence motion on Friday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) says
** United Front coalition says the Congress party has given it until 3 p.m. (0930 GMT) to respond to its demand that Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda step down
